now.title: The Defenders
now.text: In episode 3, Alexandra raises Elektra as the Black Sky to reach the treasure under Midland Circle.
cases: ST-056 The Destruction of Midland Circle (The Defenders)

changes.evidence: This record covers Alexandra's plans up to episode 3, and she is killed by Elektra in episode 6 ('Ashes, Ashes'). Midland Circle is destroyed in episode 8 ('The Defenders'), after her death, so the Destruction of Midland Circle report does not match anything in this record.

now.title: The Defenders
now.text: In episode 7, Murakami fights the Defenders as the Hand digs under Midland Circle.
cases: ST-056 The Destruction of Midland Circle (The Defenders)

changes.evidence: This record is the episode 7 fight inside Midland Circle, which ends with the Hand leaders retreating behind a gas fire. The building is blown up and collapses in episode 8, which is k1's record and already carries ST-056. The record ends before the destruction, the same pattern as the Coney Island example in the brief.
